business_problem: Schaeffler was manually processing purchase-order confirmations, PDFs, and follow-up emails across SAP and Coupa, which created delays, errors, and constant status-check requests.
solution_summary: Schaeffler was manually processing purchase-order confirmations, PDFs, and follow-up emails across SAP and Coupa, which created delays, errors, and constant status-check requests. Schaeffler Group implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Workflow Data Fabric, App Engine, and Automation Engine. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; App Engine builds custom workflow apps; Automation Engine automates cross-system tasks. The stack also connected SAP and Coupa so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, and uses context from SAP and Coupa before ServiceNow AI Platform, Workflow Data Fabric, App Engine, and Automation Engine routes or fulfills the work.
